arabesque.heading: تحدي شهري لرسم شخصية من التراث العربي
arabesque.text:
أرابيسك مجتمع أسسه إسلام أبو شادي مع أحمد نبيل عام ٢٠١٦: كل شهر شخصية من التاريخ والتراث العربي والإسلامي يرسمها آلاف الفنانين بأسلوبهم. عُرضت أعمال المجموعة في مؤتمر الشارقة للرسوم المتحركة والقصص المصورة ٢٠٢٦.

Arabesque is a monthly challenge Eslam co-founded with Ahmed Nabil in 2016: one character from Arab and Islamic heritage, drawn by thousands of artists across the region. Its work was exhibited at the Sharjah Animation & Comics Conference in October 2026.

items.text: Runs the studio's art department. Co-director and layout lead on the animated series Zakia AlZakeya. Lead artist on an upcoming comic series.
Illustrations for more than twenty issues of Star Wars and Marvel board games, including X-Men: Mutant Insurrection.
Initial character designs for the Stardust episode of Kizazi Moto: Generation Fire, produced with Triggerfish.
Directed the animated series Space Delivery and designed its characters and storyboards. Art director for the TV series Suhail and director of its animated sequences.
Character design, concept art and storyboards for the series Badr on J Channel. Directed and designed the series Union Force.
Character design, concept art and storyboards for an unannounced animated feature. Storyboards and concept art for Vodafone, Nesquik, Edita and Juhayna commercials.
Character design and concept art for the studio's mobile games.

about.title: About
about.text:
Eslam Aboshady is a character designer, art director and comic artist from Alexandria, based in Cairo. Self-taught, he left a law degree for drawing and started freelancing in 2012. Since then he has art-directed commercials, an animated feature in development and two series, designed for Disney, Fantasy Flight Games, MBC and Vodafone, and illustrated comics for publishers in the UK and the Gulf.

In 2020 he co-founded Jump Animation in Cairo with Ehab ElKholey, Mostafa AbdelGawad and Ahmed AbdelWarith, a 2D studio of 40+ artists where he directs and leads the art department. Jump's work includes the Majid TV series Zakia AlZakeya, the teaser for the feature The Grand Night (Annecy MIFA 2020 selection) and the comic series The Legend of Antara.

His drawing sits between animation design and manga: exaggerated silhouettes, heavy ink, and characters already mid-action on the model sheet. Much of his personal work returns to Arab and Islamic history, from Antara and Saif ibn Dhi Yazan to Abbas ibn Firnas. That is also the brief of Arabesque, the monthly challenge he co-founded in 2016 with Ahmed Nabil, where thousands of artists across the region draw one heritage character a month.

He works in Arabic and English, in Photoshop and Procreate.
